decisions.decision: #19: closeVote() branches in the engine (evIs redesign and voteRound 1 goes to closeRound1); one new mod:do action openRound2; G.voteRound 1/2 only under #19
decisions.why: keeps the mod button and every driver's single closeVote call; rejected a separate closeRound1 action (second button for the same intent)

decisions.decision: Interim tally is pure (tallyVotes): weighted, no-vote = Skip, hidden bonus excluded; voteResult null in VOTE_INTERIM; timer cleared at closeRound1 and openRound2
decisions.why: AC-21 needs no voter names anywhere (yesterday's voteResult names voters), AC-22 forbids side effects; a stale timer would revive in round 2 (common.js:21)

decisions.decision: #20: resolveNight(defer) stashes prebuilt feed entries + a feed mark; publishNight({gated}) runs once per closeNight (after drawEvent, gated iff status; early returns ungated), splicing at the mark
decisions.why: follows ADR 0002 and AC-33; keeps feed, report and Date.now order on non-#20 nights (AC-34), covers game-over and day-5 returns; rejected deck peek (couples closeNight to deck) and feed retraction

decisions.decision: Classify by construction: only the Burnout headline is public; closeNight's NDA and Meeting Hijack lines join the stash as status lines; Reply-All and drawEvent lines stay immediate
decisions.why: AC-29/AC-30: public sees only Burnout names plus the announcement; the hijack line is a Trap Card message; text sniffing is brittle

decisions.decision: Hidden card state lives on G.event (extra, onCall, fullReport), self-clearing at next drawEvent; common() never spreads G.event; new view fields omitted when inactive
decisions.why: no extra reset code and no leak path; omitted fields keep stage A golden byte-identical

decisions.decision: Moderator view: statusReport shown with or without secrets; onCall id only with secrets
decisions.why: the timeline already shows the full night report to the moderator; the mod screen may be projected so identity is secret-gated; owner can flip with a one-line change

decisions.decision: #16: strip EMOJIS, trim, count Array.from length (spaces count); emoji-only exempt, mixed uses 1 quota; length check before the 200 slice; view exposes chatLeft and chatLimit
decisions.why: AC-2/4/6/8, and FE must pre-check before sendChat clears input; UTF-16 length rejected (Thai combining marks)

decisions.decision: BE lands in 2 stages: A = refactors, deck 15, golden green on unchanged snapshot; B = cards + re-record golden, mod-actions, then http-parity; GOLDEN_SEEDS default >= 40
decisions.why: golden cannot prove unchanged behaviour once the deck grows, so stage A is the evidence for AC-19/28/34; http-parity hashes cover FE files and the design doc

decisions.decision: Ownership: FE app/public and app/tools; BE app/src, app/test, app/package.json; docs-writer and Orchestrator as prose lines; AC-43 already met by commit 129f3b7
decisions.why: table accepts only FE/BE/devops and one owner per file; data.js is BE's with fixed keys purge, hands, uat, redesign, status so FE codes against the contract
